located_observations.location: left product, shade ends and base
located_observations.observation: One full forest-green product has a broad curved horizontal shade, two vertical connected supports and an oval base. Photo texture and illuminated underside are visible.

located_observations.location: shade outline and lower paper plane
located_observations.observation: A drafted contour follows the actual shade edge and joins a horizontal extension; long paper outlines and a warm light footprint organise the lower composition.
Shade edge points toward title, followed by the two explanation sentences. Paper/light plane leads to adjacent event and visit groups; event and visit groups share a near baseline.
Visit conditions, invitation and URL are approximately 9–10 px tall and visibly smaller than event details. This group is pressed close to the bottom/right edge.
Full lamp and title are the strongest anchors; lower practical copy is strongly subordinate.

residuals.limit: Visit conditions, invitation sentence and URL are too small relative to the explanation and event copy; enlargement and wrapping need more area.

residuals.location: usage720 right side between explanation and lower groups
residuals.limit: There is a substantial vertical gap before the practical details, weakening continuity.

product_identity.observation: Observed forest-green colour, intact curved wide shade, exactly two visible supports attached at shade/base collars, oval base.

substantive_visual.observation: Full photographic lamp, the outline attached to its shade and the large warm footprint on the drawn paper plane carry the structure/light invitation.

assigned_style.observation: Precise contour lines and a full-product photograph meet at real boundaries; no numbered labels, invented internal mechanisms or dimensions.

style_exclusion.observation: Visible shade-outline/paper/light relationships organise the space; practical copy nevertheless remains too subordinate at usage720 and will be enlarged.

ratio.rounding_observation: 941 is 0.5 pixel above 1672×9/16; permitted nearest-integer edge rounding. No resize.

hangul.observation: Medium-weight stable counters and consistent word spacing in the explanation; smallest visit letters lose useful counter definition at usage720.

information_relationship.observation: Title/explanation alignment and adjacent lower event/visit groups are legible as groups, but small visit copy and a large gap weaken the next step.

function_contact.observation: No hands or interaction claim to verify; invitation, free admission/purchase, no-reservation condition and URL are present. URL visually reads onbit.example/light.

material_edges.observation: Product collars, shade underside, oval base and surface texture are coherent; outline is intentionally offset along the shade and paper edge.
